usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/flux-2-pro/generate with JSON body {prompt}; returns async {jobId}; then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} (SIWX, free) until status==complete
usage.outputShape: POST body.jobId (job id) + body.status:"pending". Final result on poll: body.status=="complete", body.result.imageUrl (Vercel Blob webp URL); also body.progress, body.input.* (model/resolution/aspect_ratio/output_format), body.error
quirks: Async: the paid POST returns {success,jobId,status:'pending'} — NOT the image. Must poll.

Poll URL is https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} via GET — this is SIWX-gated (returns 402 'SIWX authentication required' without a wallet proof) but is FREE (no USDC charge). Use --siwx / a SIWX signer.
Do NOT confuse status paths: /api/generate/status/{id} and /api/generate/flux-2-pro/{id} return 405 (wrong method/route); only /api/jobs/{id} works.
Final image is body.result.imageUrl (Vercel Blob, webp format, public CDN), not body.image_url.
Job completed in ~16s in this test; poll a few times with short backoff.
usage.guide: POST to https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/flux-2-pro/generate with a JSON body {"prompt":"<your image description>"}. Payment is x402 USDC on Base (~$0.02-0.03/call); no API key needed for the pay step. The POST is asynchronous — it returns {jobId,status:"pending"}, not the image. Then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId}, which requires SIWX wallet authentication (sign-in-with-x, but free — no extra charge), repeatedly with a short backoff until body.status=="complete". Read the finished image from body.result.imageUrl (a public Vercel Blob webp URL). Defaults to 1:1 aspect, 1MP, webp.
